consistency: Checkpointed streaming computation; verify the complete bounded result after native FINISHED. No multi-file reader snapshot claim.
atomicity: Checkpoint-coordinated sink recovery; no cross-system transaction claimed.
idempotency: No external producer dedup contract. A new run requires a fresh owned output path.
delete_ttl: Only example teardown; TTL not tested.
durability: One host, shared Docker volume; not independent backup or power-loss evidence.
retry: Native task restart 10 attempts with 10-second delay; controller does not reload or delete failed output.
client: Native SQL client; independent Python exact-body CSV oracle.
